name: dorm
description: Rental property operating system for Thai SME landlords

scripts.db:init: wrangler d1 migrations apply dorm-db --local -c wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.db:init:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply dorm-db --remote -c wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy
